''See also: [[Grand Oath Array Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Grand Oath Array is a highly sophisticated [[formation array]] originally created by the [[Rune Queen]] [[Emala]]. Historically, a [[Sage]] on the [[Path of Last Oath|Path of the Last Oath]] utilized this masterpiece to defeat and seal a rival [[Herald]] and his family within [[Shatterspine Castle]]. While the complete version of the array was discovered by [[Northstrider]] centuries ago, he primarily viewed it as a subject for academic research and used its underlying principles to assist in the design of pocket worlds. The array is composed of complex silver runes that require intense concentration to manipulate, as the user must manage intricate interactions involving [[Authority|authority]], will, and scripted commands. It is capable of profound effects, such as manipulating the perception of time to stretch seconds into minutes or interacting with the substance of space. Because it is built upon specialized runes, its operation and reconstruction are difficult; fragments and clues of the array were left behind in a city following [[Emala]]'s death during the [[Dread War]]. Currently, the array is in a damaged state and requires repairs to prevent it from consuming its own structure for fuel.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Grand Oath Array is a powerful mechanism capable of controlling time. Constructed by [[Emala]] using runes derived from ancient sources, the array's complex workings proved impossible for even [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]] to unravel. [[Emala]] utilized this array to seal the castle, employing a structure that contains fragments of a [[Sage]]'s [[Authority|authority]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Grand Oath Array is a time-warping masterpiece created by the [[Rune Queen]] that can be operated using a [[Path]]. To activate the array, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] manifests silver runes, allowing him to steer the device and utilize its ability to accelerate time or slow suffering. Because [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] lacked sufficient [[madra]], the array began burning its own structure to fuel itself while stowed. Consequently, the device was left in bad shape.}}
